desc: Ideation: derive characterization (max k such that for all t in [1,k]: 2*A[L+t-1] <= A[R-k+t]), reduce to static RMQ on M[i] = f(i) - i, binary search per query; validated on sample 1
Implement solve(): fast I/O via sys.stdin.buffer.read().split(); compute f[i] = bisect_left(A, 2*A[i]) (0-indexed, sentinel N); M[i] = f[i] - i
Build sparse table for range max on M plus floor-log table for O(1) queries
Per query: binary search max k in [0, len//2] with check(k): rangeMax(l, l+k-1) <= r-k+1-l (k=0 trivially true); collect answers
Test on both provided samples and edge cases (N=2, all equal values, f sentinel cases, len//2 bound) and against a brute-force greedy on random small inputs
Finalize code within required delimiters, reading stdin and writing stdout
